name: Self Centeredness
overview: Scripture calls believers to reject self-centeredness by denying themselves and following Christ, as Jesus commands in Matthew 16:24. True devotion involves loving God wholeheartedly and loving others as oneself, emphasizing humility and valuing others above personal gain (Mark 12:30-31; Philippians 2:3). Additionally, believers are urged to offer their bodies as living sacrifices to God, living in sincerity rather than for human approval (Romans 12:1; Matthew 6:1). These passages collectively teach that a Christ-centered life is marked by self-denial, humility, and sacrificial love rather than selfish ambition.
